description:
Activate Zameck Guildmage's first ability by paying {G}{U}.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Zameck Guildmage.
When the persist creature enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 2.
Repeat from step 2.
